baseline.note: Desktop ASAN debug engine, vsync off, fixed 60Hz simulation; 3 subtraction runs (600−100 frames), separate 1200-frame CPU probe. Auto-capture disabled only in fixed-population copies; chase-capture keeps natural feeding and no automatic replenishment. School measures the entire feeding tick, including resident pose; section timings overlap and must not be summed.
